description: Versatile data handling library for test executive applications. Supports import/export in multiple formats (CSV, Parquet, SQLite, Archives, .ball), data manipulation via row builder pattern and DataFrame operations, metadata storage, configuration-based relationships, and large dataset handling via chunking/partitioning. Uses backend abstraction for in-memory or out-of-core (Parquet) processing. Licensed under MPL-2.0.

formats: DataBall (.ball ZIP with Parquet + JSON metadata)

data_manipulation.row_builder: InitializeRow, ModifyField, CommitRow with relationship propagation
data_manipulation.dataframe_ops: Filter, GroupBy, Join, Sort, Aggregate (delegated to Microsoft.Data.Analysis.DataFrame)

optimization.bounce: Extract constants to metadata, row deduplication, limited chunk deduplication (max 5 tables, 4x4 to 1000x1000 matrices), optional partitioned export
optimization.squish: Full chunk deduplication (no limit), partitioning for disk storage

features_implemented.configuration: config.json for metadata, column types (int, long, float, double, bool, datetime, string), relationships (trigger/reset propagation)
features_implemented.metadata: Dictionary<string, object?> for constants and config
features_implemented.type_coercion: Automatic coercion to expected types during import/row commit

planned_features.enhanced_chunk_deduplication: Full support for complex schema (StructField, MapField) in chunk dedup; external sort-merge for large chunks
planned_features.advanced_backends: Polars/Arrow backend integration for faster ops; cloud storage (S3) support
planned_features.streaming_joins: Out-of-core join for ParquetBackend using temp partitioning
planned_features.async_operations: Full async for I/O and ops in net8.0+
planned_features.validation: Schema validation on import; data quality checks
planned_features.visualization: Integration with plotting libs (e.g., Plotly.NET) for quick reports
planned_features.data_reconstruction: From .ball with metadata reinsertion during Bounce
planned_features.extensibility: Plugin backends via reflection; custom aggregations

implementation_details.row_builder: Uses pending/original dicts for change detection; relationships reset unmodified dependents on commit; dynamic column addition with type coercion
implementation_details.bounce: ExtractConstantsToMetadata (constant columns to Metadata), DeduplicateRows (hash-based unique), PerformChunkDeduplication (hash matrix chunks to Metadata IDs; limited to 5 tables for perf)
implementation_details.squish: Full PerformChunkDeduplication (no limit), ExportToPartitionedParquet with Hive-style dirs
implementation_details.parquet_backend: Uses ParquetReader.Create, Schema.GetDataFields(), RowGroupReader.ReadColumn(DataField); streaming row groups for large data; assumes flat tabular schemas
implementation_details.in_memory_backend: Delegates to DataFrame; Parquet write via ParquetWriter.CreateAsync, DataColumn from column arrays
implementation_details.relationships: Config-loaded; on commit, if trigger changed and dependent not modified, set to null
implementation_details.type_coercion: Convert.To* for int/long/float/double/bool/DateTime; fallback to string
implementation_details.logging: NLog with file/console targets; debug/info levels
implementation_details.testing: xUnit with unit tests for row builder, Bounce, imports, MergeOrAppend, Parquet schema load
implementation_details.error_handling: DataBallException base; specific Import/ExportException; null checks for coercion/append
implementation_details.limitations: Flat schemas only (no nested Parquet); sync fallback for some I/O; single-column fallback for GroupBy/Join/Sort in v0.21.1
